newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins 560 mln skr Indonesia deal.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins 560 mln skr Indonesia deal.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson AB said on Monday it had won an order worth 560 million crowns to supply fibre access networks to the Indonesian capital of Jakarta.

Indonesian telecoms operator PT Telekom ordered the network, which would provide ordinary telephone services and Internet access and could be upgraded for wide-band services such as video conferencing, Ericsson said in a statement.
The contract also includes SDH-based equipment for transport networks, systems for multiple access multiplexing and operating and monitoring systems.
The project would be financed by the World Bank, it said.
